evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal checklist completion frames onboarding as adherence to a fixed process (conservation) while the checklist itself signals capability-building (competence).

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Framing the checklist as a replacement for a prior system appeals to continuity and keeping what works — the old page was superseded, not abandoned.
